region: TTR and modern type theories: scoped comparisons
summary: A restricted deep TTR record core: witness-sensitive ptypes, path dependency, width/depth subtyping, semantic meet for a structural merge, and relabelling under explicit model compatibility. The concrete example hook is not a TTR/MTT equivalence.

sources.citation: Cooper, R. (2023). From Perception to Communication. OUP.

definitions_mapped.note: Ptype candidates are tested against F; atomic arguments and basic types, raw list carriers restricted to functional labels.
Sound structural approximation, not a complete semantic decision procedure.
Binary structural implementation with the same-witness meet theorem, not the full normalization operation.
Explicit equivariance condition is necessary for arbitrary structured witnesses in a fixed model.

theorems.name: subb_refl / subb_trans / subb_sound
theorems.source_claim: Structural subtyping is a sound preorder under the stated well-formedness premises.

theorems.name: merge_sound
theorems.source_claim: The merged type has precisely the shared witnesses of its operands.

evidence: Assessment limited to the explicitly stated fragment; see audits/ttr_comparison.md. Mechanical results are stored separately in the .mech.json sidecar.
